scope: Phase5: separate TikTok creator-account authorization and owner-approved organic video/photo publishing using verified public media URLs; bounded manual status/history; reuse encrypted token infrastructure and existing Mezan UI. acceptance: Creator credentials must be distinct from Marketing advertiser credentials; account owner, actual token_info app_id/creator_id/scope verified
No media fetch, file upload, local storage, transcoding, autoplay, polling or unbounded list. TikTok pulls owner-verified public HTTPS URLs directly
Fresh verified URL property and creator video settings proof on preview and again before execution; finite bounded metadata, fresh scope and token expiry
Immutable owner preview, explicit exact confirmation, durable one execution claim and creator quota; ambiguous POST never retried, including with a new idempotency key
Publish share_id is a task ID, public post_ids only after read-only PUBLISH_COMPLETE, drafts are inbox delivery only
Browser-bound single-use creator OAuth nonce, existing callback compatibility, encrypted token/refreshtoken, refresh epoch/CAS and no public secrets
Comment ingress uses existing ChannelGateway encryption and tenant ownership; AI reply remains existing suggestion/review and no private model payload without specific consent
Actual Messaging scopes/readiness displayed honestly; account approval alone is not actual creator grant
Focused failing public route/UI baseline, isolated real Mongo and transport contracts; broader affected tests and CI before review/merge/release
